exposure: Closed internal cervical os strain rate (CIS)
Midpoint of the cervical canal strain rate
outcome: Diagnosis of threatened premature or preterm labor
cohort: A total of 152 pregnant women receiving prenatal examination at Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital were divided into a study group with threatened premature or preterm labor and a control group without.
finding: Shortening of cervical length and increasing closed internal cervical os strain rate (CIS) are closely related to the occurrence of premature birth and can be used as predictive indexes, with the combination of CL and CIS improving prediction accuracy.
cross-section timing: Between January 2017 and October 2017 during prenatal examination
